system.description: You conjure a magical pattern within Far range that floats above the ground. It lasts until the end of the scene or you conjure another pattern. While it is active, you may mark a Stress to move it within its Close range and make a Spellcast Roll. Each adversary within Very Close range of the pattern you succeed against takes 1d10+10 magic damage.

Place this card in your vault to open a shimmering rift to an imagined archive of ideas. You and all allies within Far range may recall a card from their vault without paying its Recall Cost.

This card can only be recalled into your loadout during a rest.

Make a Spellcast Roll against a target in Far range. On a success, spend up to 3 Hope. The effects are cumulative per Hope you spend.

  • 1 Hope: The target takes d6+6 magic damage using your Proficiency.
  • 2 Hope: The target is temporarily Dazzled. While Dazzled, they are Vulnerable and all their rolls have disadvantage.
  • 3 Hope: The spell refracts to two other targets of your choice within Close range of the first target that can also be hit, dealing half the damage and making them temporarily Dazzled.

ebWUduZrL2mnw3M4.description: Two more targets take half damage and become Dazzled.
ebWUduZrL2mnw3M4.name: Refract (+1 Hope)

effects.name: Dazzled
effects.description: While Dazzled, the target is Vulnerable and all their rolls have disadvantage.

system.description:
Make a Spellcast Roll (16). On a success, you inspire a breakthrough discovery for you and every ally within Far range.

Every target may select a card of level 4 or lower from a domain they have access to and mark Stress equal to the card's Recall Cost. The chosen card is then placed in their loadout until the end of the scene or this spell is cast again. The selected card do not count towards the maximum number of cards in their loadout and cannot be exchanged for a card in their vault.

After you successfully use this spell, place this card in your vault.
When an ally within Far range fails an action roll or rolls with Fear, you may spend a Hope to allow the target to reroll using a d20 as their Hope Die.

wndCosmicInspir0.description: The ally rerolls with a d20 as their Hope Die (applied to their next duality roll).
wndCosmicInspir0.name: Inspire

system.description:
You can craft a device as downtime move during a rest. The device is a non-magical object no larger than your hand. Describe what it is and what is its intended purpose. The device by itself cannot initiate an action, like create a fire or attack as a weapon, and it disappears if you craft a new one.

When anyone carrying the device performs an action related to its designed purpose, they may gain a +2 bonus to the roll and the device is depleted. You may spend a Hope while touching the device to recharge it.

wndCraftDevice00.description: Downtime move: craft (or replace) your device. It starts charged.
wndCraftDevice00.name: Craft Device

wndUseDevice0000.description: The carrier gains +2 on their next roll related to the device's purpose. The device is depleted.
wndUseDevice0000.name: Use Device (+2)

wndRechargeDevic.description: Spend a Hope while touching the device to recharge it.
wndRechargeDevic.name: Recharge Device

system.description: Mark a Stress to conjure a magical object within Far range. It remains in place until the end of the scene or you take Severe damage. When an ally within Close range of the object is hit by a creature in their Melee range, the attacker must make a Reaction Roll (14). On a failure, they take 2d4+4 magic damage and are pushed just outside Close range of the ally they attacked. A creature may only be targeted by one object per attack, prioritizing the closest one.

Once per rest, spend a Hope to send a mind image to an ally within Far range when they attempt to make an action roll, giving them a bonus equal to your Spellcast trait. If they roll with Hope, they gain clarity on their actions and may also clear a Stress. If they roll with Fear, they receive a disturbing vision instead, and the GM gains 1 additional Fear.

wndDreamSignal00.description: The ally adds your Spellcast trait to their next action roll. With Hope they clear a Stress; with Fear the GM gains a Fear.
wndDreamSignal00.name: Send Mind Image

system.description:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to send a magic bolt that deals d8+8 magic damage using your Proficiency.

If your Hope die rolls 8 or more, the bolt leaps to a second creature of your choice within Close range of the first. If your Fear die rolls 8 or more, the GM chooses yet another new creature within Close range of the first to also be affected by the spell. In both cases, each additional target takes half the original damage.

L2oUQCg4LWIP5Xh5.description: Each additional target takes half the original damage — apply as half damage.
L2oUQCg4LWIP5Xh5.name: Leaping Bolt (half)

system.description: Spend 2 Hope during a rest to allow you or an ally sharing the rest to take an additional downtime move.

effects.name: Gemology (+1 downtime move)
effects.description: Take one additional downtime move during this rest.

system.description:
Make a Spellcast Roll (18). On a success, you create an Imaginarium that extends within Very Far range and lasts until the end of the scene or this spell is cast again. Choose two domains. Pick up to 5 cards of level 5 or lower from those domains and mark a Stress for each card chosen. They become the Imaginarium's loadout.

While in the area, all allies may use a card from the Imaginarium's loadout as if it was in their own loadout, spending any other resources that are normally required when using the card. If a card requires a Spellcast Roll, it uses your Spellcast trait.

The GM may spend a Fear to force you to remove a card of your choice from the loadout. If this GM move removes the last card from the loadout, the spell ends.

When you Work on a Project, you may choose to work on a Masterpiece. Your Masterpiece has an initial value of 0 and when you take this downtime move, roll a d10. Add the result to its total value as handfuls of gold, then gain a Hope. When the Masterpiece's value reaches that of a chest, it is finished. You then choose a trait to gain a +1 bonus and must place this card in your vault permanently. You may also sell your Masterpiece for its current value, at which point you lose its trait bonus and can start to create a new one.

The token counter on this card tracks the Masterpiece's value in handfuls (a chest = 100 handfuls).

wndMasterpieceWk.description: Roll a d10, add it to the Masterpiece's value and gain a Hope.
wndMasterpieceWk.name: Work on the Masterpiece

system.description:
Mark a Stress to create a field within Very Close range that lasts until the end of the scene or you take Severe damage. The field moves with you and, while active, you add your Spellcast trait to your damage thresholds.

When you create the field, place 2 tokens on this card. These are your Lunar tokens. You may also spend a Hope to place 2 Lunar tokens on this card. When an ally takes damage while within the field, spend any amount of Lunar tokens to reduce the damage taken by 1d6 per token spent. When the spell ends, clear all tokens on this card.

wndMoonShieldNew.description: Creates the field (your Spellcast trait is added to your damage thresholds) and places 2 Lunar tokens on this card.
wndMoonShieldNew.name: Create Field

wndMoonShieldRed.description: Choose how many Lunar tokens to spend; roll 1d6 per token to reduce the damage an ally takes.
wndMoonShieldRed.name: Spend Lunar Tokens

wndMoonShieldEnd.description: The field ends (end of scene or Severe damage): clear all Lunar tokens.
wndMoonShieldEnd.name: End Field

effects.name: Moon Shield Field
effects.description: You add your Spellcast trait to your damage thresholds.

system.description:
Once per long rest, you may enter a state of entropic energy that lasts until the end of the scene. While in this state, you may spend the GM's Fear as if spending Hope, up to 3 per spotlight. In similar fashion, the GM may spend your Hope as if spending Fear when using adversaries' features, but only once per adversary spotlight.

The spell ends earlier if the GM has no Fear or if you have no Hope.

effects.name: Paradox Flux
effects.description: You may spend the GM's Fear as if spending Hope (up to 3 per spotlight); the GM may spend your Hope as Fear once per adversary spotlight.

system.description: Make a Spellcast Roll against up to six targets within Close range. On a success, mark any number of Stress to deal 6d6 magic damage for each Stress marked, divided equally among all targets. For each 6 rolled on a damage die for this spell, roll an additional d6.

Spend a Hope to touch a surface or object and create a flickering magical ripple no larger than your Melee range. When a creature interacts with or moves through the ripple, they must make a Reaction Roll (13). On a failure, they suffer d6+6 magic damage using your Proficiency and are temporarily Restrained. The ripple lasts until triggered or until your next rest.

ymSD0zwGMzrGWGKQ.description: The triggering creature makes a Reaction Roll (13). On a failure: d6+6 magic damage and Restrained.
ymSD0zwGMzrGWGKQ.name: Ripple Triggered

system.description:
Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal d6 magic damage using your Proficiency and you may spend a Hope to make the target temporarily Inscribed. While Inscribed, the target cannot benefit from advantage.

If you use this spell as part of a Tag Team Roll, you instead deal d10 magic damage using your Proficiency.

vwAOWy7XvpTQazHo.description: Damage when used as part of a Tag Team Roll.
vwAOWy7XvpTQazHo.name: Tag Team Damage

effects.name: Inscribed
effects.description: While Inscribed, the target cannot benefit from advantage.

system.description:
You and any number of allies may share a dream during a long rest as a downtime move. Work together to describe what happens in the dream. All creatures that shared the dream gain a Hope.

Until your next long rest, when someone Helps an Ally they shared a dream with, the one helping may roll two advantage dice and take the highest result.

wndSharedDreams0.description: Downtime move: everyone who shared the dream gains a Hope.
wndSharedDreams0.name: Share a Dream

system.description:
Once per rest, you and an ally in Far range may both mark a Stress to synchronize your thoughts. Until the end of the scene or one of you mark their last Hit Point, you two gain the following benefits:

  • You and the ally gain access to level 3 or lower domain cards from either loadout. If a card requires a Spellcast Roll, it uses your Spellcast trait.
  • It costs 2 Hope to initiate a Tag Team Roll with each other.
  • Once for the duration of the spell, when one rolls a critical success, you may both gain a Hope and clear a Stress.

wndTwinnedMinds0.description: You and the targeted ally each mark a Stress and gain Twinned Minds until the end of the scene.
wndTwinnedMinds0.name: Synchronize

hZTVC42Mc78f7XLJ.description: Once per spell: on a critical success, you both gain a Hope and clear a Stress.
hZTVC42Mc78f7XLJ.name: Shared Triumph

system.description: When an ally within Close range rolls a Failure with Fear, describe how you bolster their confidence. You may spend a Hope to allow them to gain a Hope.

When 4 or more of the domain cards in your loadout are from the Wonder domain, gain the following benefits:

  • You can mark a Stress instead of spending a Hope.
  • Once per long rest, when you would mark your last Stress, clear Stress equal to your Spellcast trait instead. You must still mark any remaining Stress.

Enchanters are artisans who weave magic into objects with great insight. They study the undertones of magic in traditional items and spells, creating innovative outcomes that empower themselves and their allies. Guided by their unique perspective, enchanters shape the flow of magic into masterful creations.
backgroundQuestions: You learned your craft from someone. Who are they and what secrets have they shared with you?
You believe every creation carries a piece of its maker. What part of you do you think your creations hold?
You often talk to your creations when you work. What do you imagine they would say back?
connections: What magic do I sense on you, and why can I not identify its origin?
I've been trying to recreate something you no longer have. What was it, and why does it matter to you?
What object of mine do you secretly keep, and why have you not given it back?

system.description: Stargazers are mystics who study the stars to unlock their cosmic power, blending astronomy, astrology, and arcane insight. They read celestial patterns in the stars and assume the form of Constellations to aid allies in battle. They are known to channel the intricate energies of the cosmos, bridging the mundane world and the skies above.
backgroundQuestions: You once received a vision from the stars that still haunts you to this day. What did the stars show you?
You were born under a special celestial event. What was it and what prophecy was spoken at your birth?
What is the most beautiful thing you've ever seen in the sky?
connections: What did I predict about you that you promised would never happen?
What do I always say you're destined for, and why do you hate hearing it?
Who do you know from my life before we met, and why have you not told me yet?

system.description: Spend 3 Hope while in Constellation form to gain 1d4 Astral tokens.

wndEmpyreanCall0.description: Spend 3 Hope (less with Cosmic Help) to gain 1d4 Astral tokens.
wndEmpyreanCall0.name: Empyrean Call

system.description: Spend 3 Hope to enchant an object without marking a Stress. When you do so, the enchantment doesn't count towards the limit of active enchantments you can have, but you're still limited to a single enchantment per object.

wndIngeniousSrg0.description: Opens the Enchanting Workshop paying 3 Hope instead of a Stress.
wndIngeniousSrg0.name: Ingenious Surge

system.description:
You may touch an object within Melee range and mark a Stress to grant it the properties of a chosen enchantment of your Tier or lower. When attempting to place an enchantment on an item held or worn by an adversary, you must also make a Spellcast Roll against the target after marking a Stress. You can have only one enchantment active at a time, which last until the end of the scene, you enchant a different item or otherwise specified.

Use the action below (or the ✦ Wonder button on your sheet) to open the Enchanting Workshop.

BA1Z7ZlnqeHPdZPz.description: Spellcast Roll against the adversary holding or wearing the item.
BA1Z7ZlnqeHPdZPz.name: Enchant Adversary's Item

system.description: You can conjure star-like motes of light that hover in your hand or around a point of your choice within Far range. They stay active while you remain within Far range of them.

effects.name: Motes of Light
effects.description: Star-like motes of light hover around you.

system.description: You can sense the rhythm of magic in ordinary items. You may examine an item or creature within Very Close range to uncover if it is magical. If it is an object, you can discern its properties and understand its functions. If it is linked to a specific spell such as Rune Ward, Create Construct or Shape Material, you also learn which spell it is.

wndAppraisal0000.description: Target a token (or select an item) to reveal its magical properties in chat.
wndAppraisal0000.name: Appraise

system.description:
You have a whimsical Star Chart of the skies above representing the different stars, planets and constellations. Describe what it looks like and how you activate it.

Mark a Stress to activate your Star Chart and embody your Constellation form. You gain access to a standard attack and additional features according to the stars you have marked in your Star Chart. When you obtain a Foundation card for this class or gain a level, choose a new star to mark in your Chart.

When you transform, place a number of tokens on your character sheet equal to your Spellcast trait (minimum 1). These are your Astral tokens, and you may have a maximum of 6. When you make an action roll while in Constellation form, you must spend an Astral token. You can remain in this form until you have no Astral tokens left. You also drop out of your Constellation form if you mark your last Hit Point.

Standard attack: Melee, uses your Spellcast trait, d6 magic damage using your Proficiency.

wndConstellation.description: Mark a Stress to enter (or leave) your Constellation form.
wndConstellation.name: Embody Constellation

system.description: An astral map of someone unknown to you.
A broken wand that belonged to a powerful magician.
A leather pouch with magical crystals.

wonder-classes.name: Sextant That Doesn't Seem to Work

system.description: A sextant that doesn't seem to work.
When negotiating prices, spend a Hope to increase or reduce the final price by 1d4 handfuls of gold.
Take an additional level 1 spell or grimoire card from a domain you normally cannot access. You may change this choice when you gain a level.
When you spend an Astral token to make an action roll and roll a failure with Hope, regain the spent Astral token.

When you assume your Constellation form, you may choose an ally within Far range to be your Binary Star. While you are within Close range of your Binary Star, they add +1 to their Evasion, you can use your standard attack without having to spend an Astral token and it costs one less Hope to initiate a Tag Team Roll between the two of you. You must still spend Astral tokens to activate any features related to your standard attack.
Choose an additional star to mark in your Star Chart.
When you Help an Ally or initiate a Tag Team Roll while in Constellation form, your next Empyrean Call costs one less Hope. You may benefit from this feature only once per rest for each ally.
Regain the use of your Spellweave feature when you place an enchantment on an object.

You may Work on a Project to create a magical trinket. When you do so, spend any number of handfuls of gold up to your Tier, then roll a d8 for each one spent. Choose an item or consumable from the Loot tables with number equal to or lower than the total result of your roll. You create a temporary copy of the chosen loot and it remains active until your next long rest (or until used, if it is a consumable). Any creature can make a Reaction Roll (10) to identify the created loot as a temporary copy.

You may now have two enchantments active at the same time, but only one per object. Also, you no longer need to touch an item to place an enchantment and can do so from within Close range of the object.

In the beginning of a session, roll 2d4 and place them on this card. These are your Glimpse dice. When a target makes an action roll, you may spend one of your Glimpse dice to reduce or increase the final result equal to the die's value. Discard any unspent Glimpse dice at the end of a session.
When your Binary Star would mark any number of Hit Points, you may spend 2 Astral tokens to pull them within your Melee range and reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by 1.
While within Close range of at least one object enchanted by you, gain a +1 bonus to action rolls.

effects.name: Harmonious Magic
effects.description: Turned on automatically while you are within Close range of a creature holding an object you enchanted.

system.description: You may use your Spellcast trait when attacking with weapons enchanted by you.

You and your Binary Star now gain the feature's benefits while within Far range of each other. Whenever you use a feature, domain card or make an attack, you may consider your Binary Star's current location as the point of origin of the effect.
You may now place enchantments on items that already have features. You are still limited to a single enchantment per object.
Choose an additional star to mark in your Star Chart.

You may choose an additional downtime move during a long rest, which you must use to Work on a Project or Prepare. When using your Creative Tinkering feature, roll an additional d8 and add it to the total result.
You can spend a Hope to make a Reaction Roll (13) when you or an ally within Far range use a consumable. On a success, it is not spent. You may only use this feature once per consumable.
The Recall Cost of your level 1 domain cards is reduced by 1. Additionally, weapons enchanted by you deal additional damage equal to the number of level 1 spells in your loadout.

Once per rest, mark a Stress to choose two of your spells that require a Spellcast Roll against a single target. You may cast a combined spell by making a single Spellcast Roll against the same target, which must be within range of the two spells. You must spend any additional resources for each spell. When rolling for damage with your Spellweave, combine the initial damage of both spells into a single damage roll.
Choose an additional star to mark in your Star Chart.

Once per rest, spend a Hope to gain celestial insight until the end of the scene. For the duration of this effect, you can see through invisibility or magical darkness and creatures within Very Close range cannot be Hidden from you.

effects.name: Third Eye
effects.description: You see through invisibility and magical darkness; creatures within Very Close range cannot be Hidden from you.

system.description:
Roll an additional Glimpse die in the beginning of a session.

When you Help an Ally while in Constellation form and they roll with Fear, you may spend an Astral token to change the result to a roll with Hope instead.
Your Glimpse dice increase to d6s. When you participate in a Tag Team Roll, you may choose to reroll any number of remaining Glimpse dice.
Play the Appraiser if you want to craft items to aid your allies in and outside of battle.
Play the Astrologer if you want to support a chosen ally while channeling the cosmic forces within yourself.
Play the Clairvoyant if you want to use the stars as guidance to help your allies.
Play the Spellweaver if you want to mix, improve and experiment with your weapons and spells.
